name: Books
blurb: Animation principles, design theory and the few books about storytelling that change how you time a cut.

entries.name: Cartoon Animation
entries.note: Preston Blair's classic. Cheap, old, still the fastest route into construction and squash.

entries.name: Design for Motion
entries.note: The closest thing to a motion design textbook — process, not software.

entries.name: Grid Systems in Graphic Design
entries.note: Composition, structure, and the discipline of a layout that holds.

entries.name: In the Blink of an Eye
entries.note: Why a cut works. Short, and it will change how you time everything.

entries.name: Interaction of Color
entries.note: Colour is relative. This is the book that proves it to you.

entries.name: Motion Design: Moving Graphics for Television, Music Video, Cinema, and Digital Interfaces
entries.note: A survey of the discipline across every screen it landed on.

entries.name: Motion Graphic Design: Applied History and Aesthetics
entries.note: Where motion graphics came from and why it looks the way it does.

entries.name: Show Your Work!
entries.note: How to be found without becoming a marketer. Relevant to every freelancer here.

entries.name: Steal Like an Artist
entries.note: Permission to build on what came before, which is what everyone does anyway.

entries.name: The Animation Book
entries.note: A broad practical survey, useful for seeing the whole field at once.

entries.name: The Animator's Survival Kit
entries.note: The one everyone means when they say "read the book". Timing, spacing, weight, walks.

entries.name: The Art of Looking Sideways
entries.note: A commonplace book for the eye. Open it anywhere.

entries.name: The Elements of Typographic Style
entries.note: The reference. Dense, beautiful, worth returning to.

entries.name: The Illusion of Life: Disney Animation
entries.note: Where the twelve principles were written down. Also a history of how a craft got invented.

entries.name: Thinking with Type
entries.note: Type as a system. Read it before you animate another word.

entries.name: Timing for Animation
entries.note: Short, precise, entirely about the thing beginners get wrong.

entries.name: Understanding Comics
entries.note: Time, sequence and the space between frames — the best book about editing that is not about editing.

entries.name: Universal Principles of Design
entries.note: One principle per spread. Good for filling in the gaps you did not know you had.
